tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on The Skeletal System

questions.question: Name the five functions of the skeleton.
questions.correctAnswer: Support, protection, movement, mineral storage, blood cell production.
questions.explanation: Answer: Support, protection, movement, mineral storage, blood cell production.

questions.question: How many bones make up the axial skeleton?
questions.correctAnswer: 80 bones make up the axial skeleton.
questions.explanation: Answer: 80 bones make up the axial skeleton.

questions.question: Give one example each of a long bone, a short bone, a flat bone and an irregular bone.
questions.correctAnswer: Long: femur; Short: carpals; Flat: cranium; Irregular: vertebrae.
questions.explanation: Answer: Long: femur; Short: carpals; Flat: cranium; Irregular: vertebrae.
